credit.credit-words: Words and Music by DAVID BOWIE
A tribute to David Bowie featuring:
Rebel Rebel · The Man Who Sold The World · Life on Mars?
David Bowie is renowned for his multiple personas, innovative fashion, diverse musicianship,
and lyrics that resonate throughout generations. Here we pay tribute to his varied career,
through performing many of the works that defined it, and still shape contemporary music today.
This 9 minute medley is a celebration of Bowie’s songwriting and musicianship. We urge you,
the listener, to join us if you recognize any of the tunes. Join us in a tribute to the lasting power
and resonance of David Bowie's words.
For SSAB and Piano with Instrumental Accompaniment
Words and Music by DAVID BOWIE
